howTo.title: How it works
howTo.item1: The plugin needs no configuration. After activation the Shopware Payments entries are hidden for every user.
howTo.item2: It hides the main menu entry Shopware Payments with its sub-entries, the entry under Extensions and the tab in the order detail view.
howTo.item3: The entry under Settings deliberately stays visible, the app is still configured there.
howTo.item4: The Shopware Payments app and its payment methods stay active and unchanged. Do not deactivate the app, otherwise the cookie settings in the Storefront keep loading forever.
howTo.item5: To show the entries again, deactivating this plugin is enough.

info.description: Hides the Shopware Payments entries from the admin. The app and its payment methods stay untouched.
